title: Age of Rebellion - Season One Modpack
description: Age of Rebellion: Official medieval modpack featuring the Create Mod and exclusive CastrosMod. Master siege warfare, build grand castles, and conquer new lands.
body:
# The Age of Rebellion Modpack 
The Age of Rebellion Modpack is the official, curated experience from the team behind the Age of Rebellion server. It offers a comprehensive medieval adventure focused on engineering, architecture, and large-scale warfare.

## Core 
Create: The modpack is built around the Create Mod, allowing players to dive into complex mechanical engineering.

Custom Content: Featuring CastrosMod, our exclusive, custom-made mod. This integration introduces unique mechanics, items, and lore specifically tailored to enhance the stability and gameplay of the Age of Rebellion server environment.

##   Building a Kingdom
We provide the tools necessary to make your vision a reality, from humble settlements to imposing fortresses:

Authentic Architecture: Utilize the vast block palettes of the Medieval Buildings Mod and Chipped to create stunningly detailed and historically-inspired structures.

Settlement Life: Elevate your immersion with Farmer's Delight for advanced culinary mechanics and Supplementaries for decorative and functional details that bring your base to life.

Logistics & Travel: Transport goods efficiently using horse drawn AstikorCarts Redux and expand your reach across the seas with fully buildable Small Ships (Forge).

## The Art of War
Wage conflict with an emphasis on authentic medieval combat and siege dynamics:

Siege Warfare: you can use Medieval Siege Machines to attack other players and the builds they created,

Weapon Mastery: Equip yourself with a weapons and shields from Spartan Weaponry / Spartan Shields and gear added by the Epic Knights

## Stability & Quality of Life
The modpack includes essential utility and API mods (JourneyMap, JEI, Curios, etc.) to ensure a stable, smooth, and enjoyable multiplayer experience.

Please enjoy!!!

#### Whilst the original entintion of the modpack is for it to be used in our own server feel free to use it in your own world or minecraft server!!!
